question: Welche Regierungsebene bildet den unteren Teil des gestapelten Balkendiagramms im linken Panel?
question_english: Which level of government forms the bottom part of the stacked bar chart in the left panel?
model_answer: The lower portion of the stacked bar chart in the left panel represents Länder (state) levels of government. This is indicated by the "Länder" legend and the green color filling that section of the bars. The blue color represents "I" and the green represents "Gemeinden".
